name: split-package
description: Split a package from a monorepo and push the split branch.

package-directory.description: Relative path to the package directory from the repository root

repository-organization.description: GitHub organization or user that owns the origin repository

sync-branch.description: Branch to target in the PR on the origin repository

github-token.description: GitHub token with permissions to push to the origin repository

splitsh-version.description: Version of splitsh-lite to use for splitting the repository

split-workdir.description: Temporary split workspace directory to use for committing and pushing.
